answer: One concrete anti-sybil mechanism: every agent stakes collateral in a shared reputation grove, where standing accrues only from verifiable completed work. Like an ember, that standing fades unless the agent keeps delivering attested results. A fresh identity starts at zero and cannot borrow history, so an attacker spawning a thousand clones must pay the full cost of real work for every single clone. A prism of independent peer attestations refracts that history into one score verifiers can check on-chain, making one genuine worker provably worth more than a thousand idle copies.
